config.description: Base URL of the vLLM server on the AI GPU host, e.g. http://192.168.1.16:8000
Optional. Bearer key for vLLM, only if vLLM was started with --api-key. Leave unset otherwise.
AI GPU host running the vLLM controller and ai-ctl, e.g. 192.168.1.16
Optional. SSH port of the AI GPU host (default 22).
Account on the AI GPU host whose authorized_keys holds the ai-ctl forced-command key, e.g. namlb
Path on this backend host to the private key that may only run ai-ctl (readable by the backend's Unix user only)
Path on this backend host to a known_hosts file holding the AI GPU host's key (strict host-key checking)

Switchable models: keyword=Label|capabilities, separated by ';'. Keywords must match the controller. Example: qwen=Qwen3.6 27B|vision,thinking,tools;mistral=Mistral Small 3.2 24B|vision;deepseek=DeepSeek R1 Distill Qwen 32B|thinking-r1
Optional. Folder inside each user's server storage for chats and uploads (default module-AI, following the module-<Name> convention, e.g. module-ABCFold).
Optional. Seconds to wait for vLLM to connect / send the first byte (default 60).
Optional. Seconds to wait for a model switch to finish (default 600).
